headline: Deputy PM and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar met OIC Secretary-General Ismail Ould Cheikh Ahmed in Islamabad on Sunday, and both reiterated support for the people of Palestine and Jammu and Kashmir, Arab News reports.

card.desc: OIC Secretary-General ka Islamabad ka pehla daura.

caption:
Pakistan aur OIC ne Kashmir aur Falasteen ki himayat dohrai! 🇵🇰
Arab News ke mutabiq Deputy PM aur Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar ne Sunday ko Islamabad mein OIC ke Secretary-General Ismail Ould Cheikh Ahmed se mulaqat ki. Foreign Office ke mutabiq dono ne Falasteen aur Jammu o Kashmir ke logon ki mazboot himayat dohrai. OIC chief ka ohda sambhalne ke baad yeh un ka Islamabad ka pehla daura hai. Unhon ne Iran aur America ke tanaze ke dauran aman ke liye Pakistan ki koshishon ki tareef bhi ki. Yeh mulaqat Islamabad mein ECO ke do roza ijlas ke mauqe par hui.
Kya OIC Muslim duniya ke masail hal kar sakti hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
